column2: As Amara, I want to view each village’s latest technician check-in and reading-submission status so I can identify villages needing follow-up.
column3: Build village-status API using latest check-ins and submitted readings.
Build the village dashboard with check-in and reading status.
Flag villages with no check-in or reading update for more than 24 hours.
Test current status and the 24-hour stale-update boundary.
Integrate live data and fix dashboard acceptance-test defects.

column2: As a technician, I want to record my village check-in with time, location and notes so Amara can track visits.
column3: Define shared village/meter data and save authenticated technician check-ins.
Build the check-in form for village, time, location and notes.
Persist offline or invalid-location check-ins locally as pending sync.
Integrate check-in visibility for Amara and pending-location handling.
Test online save, offline persistence and invalid-location pending status.

column2: As Amara, I want technicians’ submitted readings to be validated and stored so the dashboard shows reliable reading status.
column3: Create the shared reading API and storage for meter/village, value, unit and date.
Validate reading values and reject invalid or non-numeric submissions.
Connect reading submission and validation messages to dashboard status.
Integrate queued readings with the shared sync service and dashboard.
Test valid and invalid readings plus offline submission and later sync.

column2: As a technician, I want to enter meter readings and see previous values and anomaly warnings so I can capture accurate readings offline or online.
column3: Build meter selection and value/unit/date entry using the shared reading API.
Retrieve and display the previous reading for the selected meter.
Implement anomaly warnings and preserve the entered reading for review.
Connect meter entry to offline queueing and verify previous-value/anomaly paths.

column2: As a technician, I want queued data to sync when connectivity returns so check-ins and readings reach Amara without being lost.
column3: Build shared persistent queue and reconnect-triggered sync for both record types.
Handle conflicts and failed sync with retained queue items and safe retries.
Show pending/synced/error states and add manual retry controls.
Integrate end-to-end sync and ensure retries do not create duplicate records.
Test reconnect, conflict, failed retry and recovery across all five stories.
